name: cache-keeper
description: Observes prompt-cache usage, keeps the session's and its finished subagents' caches warm, and runs 5m/1h TTL A/B experiments.

enabled.title: Keeper on by default
enabled.description: Keep every session warm unless /cache-keeper stop turns it off there. Off: only /cache-keeper start turns it on.

dataDir.title: Data directory
dataDir.description: Where events, run records and reports are written: absolute, under ~ (the home directory), or relative to the session's working directory.

minCacheReadTokens.title: Minimum cached prefix (tokens)
minCacheReadTokens.description: The keeper only refreshes a cached prefix at least this large.

ttl5mKeepaliveAtSec.title: 5m keepalive after (seconds)
ttl5mKeepaliveAtSec.description: Idle seconds since the last request started before a 5-minute cache is refreshed.

ttl1hKeepaliveAtSec.title: 1h keepalive after (seconds)
ttl1hKeepaliveAtSec.description: Idle seconds since the last request started before a 1-hour cache is refreshed.

maxRateLimitPercent.title: Stop at usage percent
maxRateLimitPercent.description: The keeper stops once any rate-limit window reaches this percent.

maxConsecutiveProbeFailures.title: Stop after failed probes
maxConsecutiveProbeFailures.description: Consecutive failed or missed keepalives before the keeper stops.

maxIdleKeepalives.title: Keepalives per idle stretch
maxIdleKeepalives.description: Keepalives allowed between two real requests (3 covers about four idle hours at a 1-hour TTL). 0 = the API-price break-even against one cache rewrite.

subagentKeepalives.title: Keepalives per finished subagent
subagentKeepalives.description: Times a finished subagent's cache is refreshed in case it is sent another message (2 covers about 2.7 hours at a 1-hour subagent TTL). 0 = never.

probePrompt.title: Probe prompt
probePrompt.description: The one user message a keepalive or benchmark probe sends.

ledgerSnapshot.title: Ledger snapshot on the last keepalive
ledgerSnapshot.description: The last keepalive of an idle stretch asks the model, over the same cached prefix, which tasks are still open and what their next step is, and publishes them in its state for ctx-mod to book before it switches windows. Off: every keepalive sends the plain probe prompt.

writeJson.title: Write experiment-summary.json
writeJson.description: Have /cache-keeper report write the JSON summary.

showStatus.title: Status line entry
showStatus.description: Show the keeper's state in the status line (off by default: the bar above the prompt already shows it).

shadowMode.title: Shadow mode (record, never send)
shadowMode.description: Record each keepalive the keeper would have sent as a would_have_keepalive event, and record the real gap until the next request, without sending anything. Off by default; existing keepalive behavior is unchanged.

bridgeEnabled.title: Quota bridge
bridgeEnabled.description: At bridgeAtPercent of the 5-hour window, tell the main session to wrap up, keep its cache warm until the reset, then tell it to continue. Only sessions worked in within the last 10 minutes or the cache TTL, whichever is shorter (a user message, a turn still running, or background tasks still out), so a session that ended hours ago is never woken; never subagents.

bridgeAtPercent.title: Bridge at 5h percent
bridgeAtPercent.description: 5-hour usage percent that sends the wrap-up message.

weeklyHandoffAtPercent.title: Handoff at weekly percent
weeklyHandoffAtPercent.description: Weekly usage percent that asks the main session, once per weekly window, to write a handoff document for a new conversation to pick up after the reset. Only sessions with a user or assistant message in the last ten minutes, or with background tasks still out. 0 = never.
